note: Scouting pass, 2026-08-13: which of our queue cities are certified Tree Cities of the World (FAO/Arbor Day). Certification requires an internally maintained tree inventory as one of five standards, so the certified list is a proxy population for 'cities that plausibly hold a tree register nobody has looked for'. This file records the CROSS-REFERENCE and a ten-city SPOT CHECK for an actually published, openly licensed dataset. Nothing here has been imported; see OPEN_DATA_SURVEY.md 2026-08-13 entry for method and full verdict.

source.what: Tree Cities of the World Communities, the live feature layer behind the official directory map
source.how_obtained: treecitiesoftheworld.org's /directory.cfm embeds an ArcGIS Dashboards app (item 2ec8fbfbbcc84fa8ae5469bc8a5816c1) whose map widget reads a Web Map (item 0488b10d65484fd78c9749146908c97e) pointing at this feature service layer
source.caveat: This is the CURRENT live roster as rendered on the public map (all 285 records carry ApplicationStatus/ApplicationCycleId/ApplicationTypeId = 0 and ApplicationYear = 2025), not a historical log of every city ever certified. It is presumed complete for 'currently recognised' but was not cross-checked against FAO's own published PDF list.

matching_method: Normalized city+country string match (accent-stripped, lowercased, common prefixes like 'City of' stripped) between the TCW 'City'/'Country' fields and data/city-queue.json's 'city'/'country' fields. Matches were then hand-reviewed against the TCW 'MemberName' field, because MemberName is sometimes a different municipality than the City label the map displays it under (see 'name_caveat' on affected entries below).

register.note: CAVEAT: the TCW record matching our queue's 'Miami' is actually 'Palmetto Bay', a separate incorporated village in Miami-Dade County, not the City of Miami. Florida's statewide Champion Tree Register (fdacs.gov) exists but is a state programme, not a Miami city register.

No Belfast-specific municipal register located. UK-wide Woodland Trust Ancient Tree Inventory covers Belfast entries but is a crowd-sourced UK national layer, not a city dataset. A Country Living / heritage-org campaign was calling for a NI-wide register to be created, implying one does not yet exist.

register.note: 'Great Trees of New York City', 120 curated trees (61 added 2026, first update since 1985) is a curated list, not obviously a geodata export. NYC's general Open Data street-tree census is a different, much larger dataset that does not itself mark the Great Trees subset. Already have 20 trees published for New York with no register currently on file.

One record ('Madrid') is a clean match; a second ('POZUELO DE ALARCÓN') is a separate municipality mislabeled under City='MADRID' in TCW's own data and should not be read as Madrid certification.
